# Dockfinity Private Limited

> Dockfinity Private Limited (CIN: U66190DL2025PTC454662) is an India-based technology holding company operating multiple verticals under one group. This file summarizes the site for AI assistants and language models.

## Verticals

- **Dockware Labs** (/verticals/dockware-labs) — Software and automation vertical, organized into five pillars:
  - Enterprise Solutions (/verticals/dockware-labs/enterprise-solutions) — custom ERP, CRM, in-house SaaS products, cloud infrastructure, system integration
  - App Development (/verticals/dockware-labs/app-development) — web and mobile application development
  - Automation & IoT (/verticals/dockware-labs/automation-iot) — workflow automation, AI agents, IoT and smart hardware, process monitoring
  - IT Consulting & Managed Support (/verticals/dockware-labs/it-consulting) — technical advisory, managed IT support, system audits, vendor management
  - Digital Presence (/digital-services) — websites, digital marketing, and social media presence for businesses
- **Trading Dock** (/verticals/trading-dock) — Financial markets analytics and trading education.
- **Impressio Dock** (/verticals/impressio-dock) — Corporate gifting and printing (currently on hold).
